fact: Libya's communications authority took part in senior officials' meetings in Tunis in November 2026 that agreed three draft memoranda on telecommunications, radio communications and broadcasting for signing at the 23rd Libyan-Tunisian joint high commission.
title: هيئة الاتصالات تشارك في الاجتماعات التحضيرية للجنة العليا الليبية التونسية المشتركة
